title: Should I Run the Triple Crown?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Finally…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Finally…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's finally time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is right before my eyes! There's no getting away from it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is the biggest series of races for Umamusume in their classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each race is a big event that, of course, Mejiro Palmer can't very well ignore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whaddya think? Should I run in it? Or, better yet…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Why don't we both race? We're in the same year, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's a no from me, sis. I've already decided I'm going for sprints! ☆ You should totally run it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see… What about you, Trainer? You for it or against it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Figures you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm… What to do… All things considered…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I should probably do it. Running in the Triple Crown is, like, what Mejiros are expected to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But what happens if I get out there and flub it? I might end up being an embarrassment to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, hold on. I gotta think simple. I'm aiming to be the best Palmer I can be, not the best Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I need to decide what's best for myself, not what's best for the family. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is something I should really be serious about, right?
choice_data_list: I'd say that's the typical approach.
I'd say that's the typical approach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then maybe I should run it. That's probably what's best for me as well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Or is it? If I'm not up to snuff for that level of running, then will it really be what's best for me? Won't it just be a slap in the face from reality?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Agh! I need to be more optimistic! Good vibes! Good vibes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I can't remember a time where being optimistic has worked out for me before. I've never overcome anything from talent alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm totally stuck! What do I do?! Somebody point me in the right direction!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, like… Don't you think you're overthinking this whole thing?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't think—feel! ☆ Do you wanna run or don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Feel, huh? The thing is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've never been good at knowing what I want to do. I've always done what others wanted me to do. What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You should decide for yourself, even if you're not used to it.
You should decide for yourself, even if you're not used to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Uh, Trainer? Why do you look so serious?
choice_data_list: That's what it means to live your own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Live my own way… That was my original goal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to leave this choice up to her. She needs to think, learn, and decide on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Until she can do that, I don't think she'll be able to make any progress toward becoming the Umamusume she wants to be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …Got it! This is something I've to figure out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: First things first, I've gotta figure out what I really want in my heart of hearts. Hm…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nnngh… This is tough! But I'm gonna do it! So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gimme a little time! I'm gonna give it some serious thought, so just give me a moment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer runs off, ears twitching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (What do you wanna do, Palmer? Think, think, think…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, the weight of this responsibility is heavy as heck! I don't wanna deal with it! But… I don't wanna ignore it either.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I wanna laugh, not be laughed at. Aspiration, obligation, responsibility, goals…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I got it! I know how I feel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Mejiro Palmer asks me and Daitaku Helios to meet her so she can deliver her answer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let us have it, girl! Speak your truth! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right! I've been thinking about whether or not I wanna run in the Classic Triple Crown tour! And my conclusion on my feelings is that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a moment, even the wind pauses as if in expectation. And then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I dunno!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You… don't know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nope! I don't know a single thing! I dunno, and everything's a mess. Part of me wants run and part of me's scared, and I've no idea what's up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've never been good enough, so I always just try to keep my head down so I don't bother anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So even if you tell me to get in touch with my true self and say what I really feel all of a sudden, it's not like I can just snap my fingers and do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Anyway, that's how I feel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something childish about her outburst, but hearing her thoughts like this…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pffft… bwahahaha! Hey, why not? ♪ Not knowing is the best, I say! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I mean, who really knows what they know or don't know? Us girlypops are all about the vibes, anyway! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Vibes, huh? Yeah… You're right… I think you're onto something there. I just gotta feel the vibes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: If you don't know, then you don't know. And what's wrong with that? There's still a way for you to decide!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There is?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just see how you feel when the race gets closer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You mean I should let my feelings decide? Right before the Classic Triple Crown?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Just let your gut feeling have the final say. If you still don't feel like running when the time arrives…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just send Trainer a sad emoji or something. ♪ Throwing in two or three crying ones for good measure. ★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What?! You want me to break the news through emojis?! But wouldn't that put you in a really tough position, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What?! You're actually on board with that?!
choice_data_list: If you're not into it, you won't be able to run well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether it's based on her feelings or vibes or whatever else, I want Mejiro Palmer to do what she feels is right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I get the feeling the Classics will be right for her. They're the first place she can run as her actual self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, got it. Let's talk about it again when the races get closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If the vibes feel right, I'll run. Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our plans for the Classic Triple Crown is… to run if she feels like it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man… Is this seriously the kind of person I am? Then again…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess being free really means I can do whatever I want. Yeah… I can do whatever I want…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's going on?! What's this fluttering feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I feel more alive than I ever have before! Yikes… I'm trembling like mad too!
